proposed_rules.trigger: A vertical stack of labeled inputs (text, radio, textarea) ending in a submit control, forming an application/contact form.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit ONE 'form' block, one row per field (label + input type/placeholder), final row = submit. Rejected alternative: leave as raw inline HTML form with no block wrapper (loses EDS authoring/reuse for the field list).
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurring form structure on this site warrants a dedicated reusable block rather than page-specific markup.

provenance.evidence: C166 rc1c2c3c2 13 labeled fields + submit button

proposed_rules.trigger: A '2x1' zone with 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA text plus a '| |' separator at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the site-wide footer fragment, excluded from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical across every captured page = global chrome, analogous to knack-announcement-bar.

notes: Non-profit pricing sub-page dominated by a discount-application form; small FAQ with collapsed answers; global footer/cookie chrome.
